card.name: Linking words before a following phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas such as "on" after "educate them", a comma in a list of routes, or "of" in "out of reach". They sit just before the phrase that completes a counseling or warning statement.

modes.label: Educate them on
modes.description: The word "on" after educate or advise, before the topic the patient is taught.
modes.example: Inform patients and caregivers of this potential interaction and educate them<< on>> the signs and symptoms of respiratory depression (

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma after an item in a list of routes, or after "In fact".
modes.example: Not for oral, ophthalmic<<,>> or intravaginal use. (

modes.label: Inside set phrases
modes.description: A word in the middle of a fixed phrase such as "up-to-date" or "out of reach".
modes.example: Keep this and all medications out<< of>> reach of children.

card.writes: It slightly boosts words like policies and specialties and suppresses words about unauthorized or illegal acts, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and commas in patient-advice and warning sentences, just before the next phrase.
